deprecated_yaml.description:
The YAML configuration of the KEF speaker {name} ({host}) has been imported into the UI, with its options. The media player keeps its entity ID and settings.

Remove this speaker from the `media_player:` section of your configuration (configuration.yaml or a package), then restart Home Assistant to fix this issue:

```yaml
media_player:
  - platform: kef_connector
    host: {host}
    ...
```

The YAML options (maximum_volume, volume_step) are now the "Volume cap in Home Assistant" and "Volume step in Home Assistant" options, set in Settings > Devices & services > KEF Connector > Configure. YAML support will be removed in kef_connector 1.6 (mid-2027).
deprecated_yaml.title: The KEF Connector YAML configuration is deprecated

deprecated_yaml_import_issue_cannot_conn.description:
The YAML configuration of the KEF speaker {name} could not be imported into the UI: the speaker at {host} could not be reached.

Check that the speaker is powered and that its address is correct, then restart Home Assistant to retry. You can also add the speaker in Settings > Devices & services and remove the `- platform: kef_connector` entry from your configuration. YAML support will be removed in kef_connector 1.6 (mid-2027).
deprecated_yaml_import_issue_cannot_conn.title: The KEF Connector YAML configuration could not be imported

deprecated_yaml_import_issue_not_kef.description:
The YAML configuration of the KEF speaker {name} could not be imported into the UI: the device at {host} does not look like a KEF wireless speaker.

Fix the address and restart Home Assistant to retry, or add the speaker in Settings > Devices & services and remove the `- platform: kef_connector` entry from your configuration. YAML support will be removed in kef_connector 1.6 (mid-2027).
deprecated_yaml_import_issue_not_kef.title: The KEF Connector YAML configuration could not be imported

deprecated_yaml_import_issue_unknown.description:
The YAML configuration of the KEF speaker {name} ({host}) could not be imported into the UI because of an unexpected error (see the logs).

Add the speaker in Settings > Devices & services and remove the `- platform: kef_connector` entry from your configuration. YAML support will be removed in kef_connector 1.6 (mid-2027).
deprecated_yaml_import_issue_unknown.title: The KEF Connector YAML configuration could not be imported

data_description.max_volume: Home Assistant never sets the volume above this level; the remote and the app can still go higher. The speaker maximum volume, a setting of the speaker itself, limits every control.
data_description.volume_step: Volume change of the volume up and down actions of Home Assistant. The speaker volume step, a setting of the speaker itself, applies to its remote and buttons.
